cohort: 75 pregnant women with positive SARS-CoV-2 tests at any stage of gestation who delivered consecutively between March 31 and August 6, 2020 at an urban, safety-net hospital in Boston.
finding: Among pregnant women with positive SARS-CoV-2 tests, 41% had a cesarean delivery, 19% had a preterm birth, and 7% of their infants had positive SARS-CoV-2 tests in the first week of life.
